newsitem.title: USA: Calton to delay results, trading suspended.
newsitem.headline: Calton to delay results, trading suspended.

text.p: Calton Inc. said on Monday it is delaying the release of its year-end financial results until it completes agreement with its lenders to extend its credit facility maturity date into 1998.
The company said the American Stock Exchange has suspended trading in Calton shares pending the filing of its financial results. The stock had closed Friday at 0-3/8.

The credit facility's maturity date has been extended from February 28, 1997 to March 31, 1997, and the company said it and its lending group are finalizing the terms and conditions of an amendment which would extend the term through February 28, 1998 and, if certain milestones are attained, August 31, 1998.

Calton said its disclosures about capital resources and liquidity cannot be finalized until negotiations with the lenders are completed, so it has deferred the filing and release of its year-end financial statements until the execution of the amended facility.
Calton said no assurances can be given that an amended facility will be executed on terms and conditions favorable to the company.
